title: A Summer for the Vow
author: Rosalind Ishikawa
blurb: Theo Amberdale, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
